title: ProSearch: Benchmarking Multi-Constraint Protocol Retrieval in Experimental Science
abstract: arXiv:2610.41396v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In AI for Science scenarios, experimental design and method reproduction require retrieving protocols that satisfy multiple interdependent constraints, yet existing benchmarks lack systematic evaluation of this capability. To address this gap, we introduce ProSearch, a benchmark for multi-constraint protocol retrieval in experimental science. ProSearch has three key features: (1) realism, with queries grounded in real experimental records and expert-defined templates; (2) complexity, with 60 experimental fields and their dependencies; and (3) diagnosticity, with 3-5 explicit constraints per query, including numerical and negation constraints. We construct ProSearch through LLM-based extraction, data-driven constraint selection, controlled query generation, and evidence-based relevance validation. The resulting benchmark contains 1,515 queries across six experimental science domains. We conduct extensive experiments on ProSearch with 19

translated_title: ProSearch：实验科学中多约束协议检索的基准测试
translated_abstract: 在“AI for Science”（科学人工智能）场景中，实验设计和方法复现需要检索满足多个相互依赖约束的实验方案，然而现有基准缺乏对这一能力的系统性评估。为填补这一空白，我们提出了ProSearch，一个面向实验科学多约束协议检索的基准。ProSearch具有三个关键特性：（1）真实性，查询基于真实实验记录和专家定义的模板；（2）复杂性，涵盖60个实验领域及其相互依赖关系；（3）诊断性，每个查询包含3-5个显式约束，包括数值约束和否定约束。我们通过基于大语言模型的信息抽取、数据驱动的约束选择、受控的查询生成以及基于证据的相关性验证来构建ProSearch。最终形成的基准包含横跨六个实验科学领域的1,515个查询。我们在ProSearch上使用19个（模型/系统）开展了大量实验……
tldr: 提出了ProSearch基准，用于系统评估AI在实验科学中检索满足多个相互依赖约束的实验方案的能力，该基准基于真实实验记录构建，包含跨六个领域的1,515个带有显式约束的查询。
